descriptionChirho: An adjective describing soldiers who travel and fight on foot, i.e. infantry, as opposed to cavalry or charioteers. The singular (Adj-ms) and plural (Adj-mp) forms represent the same meaning: eng foot-soldiers/footmen, spa de-a-pie/los-que-corren-a-pie, hin पैदल/पैरों, arb رَاجِلٍ/المُشَاةِ, kor 보병/발들-과, swa waendao-kwa-miguu/miguu. All translations consistently refer to pedestrian warriors or those proceeding on foot.
